tools.name: search_places
tools.description:
Find restaurants, cafes, bakeries, breweries, farms, farm stands, farmers markets and
other food and drink places in Vermont, from Eat Vermont's reviewed directory. Filter by
words, town, kind of place, distance from a point, open right now, or Insider perks.
With `near`, results are nearest first a

tools.name: get_place
tools.description:
Full details of one place found with search_places: opening hours (Vermont time),
street address, website and social links, amenities, season (for farmers markets),
upcoming events there, and the food trails it is on. Includes its eatvermont.com `url`.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description:
Upcoming food and drink events in Vermont (dinners, tastings, markets, festivals, live
music at food venues), soonest first. Only today and later. Filter by date range, words,
town, category or distance from a point. Each result lists its upcoming dates and an
eatvermont.com `url`. Use get_event for

tools.name: get_event
tools.description:
Full details of one upcoming event found with search_events: all upcoming dates and
times, venue and address, fee, host, a link for tickets or more information, and its
eatvermont.com `url`.

tools.name: list_trails
tools.description:
Eat Vermont's food trails: themed routes of places to visit (for example creemee
stands or breweries), with how many stops each has. Use get_trail for the stops.

tools.name: get_trail
tools.description:
One food trail with its stops in order (each stop links to its place page), any
current challenge and reward, and its eatvermont.com `url`.

tools.name: catalog_info
tools.description:
How many places, upcoming events and trails Eat Vermont lists, the exact values the
filters accept (towns, kinds of place, amenities, event and trail categories), and the
terms of use. Call this to pick valid filter values.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places, get_place, search_events, get_event, get_trail · Public sink: search_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places, get_place, search_events, get_event, get_trail · Public sink: search_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "catalog_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "How many places, upcoming events and trails Eat Vermont lists, the exact values the
filters accept (towns, kinds of place, amenities, event and trail categories), and the
terms of use. Call this to pick valid filter values." → after: "How many places, upcoming events and trails Eat Vermont lists, the exact values the
filters accept (towns, kinds of place, amenities, event and trail categories), and the
terms of use. Call this to pick valid filter values, and only while answering a
question about Vermont food, drink, farms, market"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
